description_en: Deletes an alert whitelist rule with the specified ID
description_zh: 删除指定ID的告警加白规则
name: DeleteWhiteRuleList

parameters.help_en: The unique ID of the whitelist rule
parameters.name: id

parameters.help_en:
The view type.

- 0: The view for the current Alibaba Cloud account.

- 1: The view for all accounts in the enterprise
parameters.help_zh:
视图类型。

- 0：当前阿里云账号视图。
- 1：企业下所有账号的视图
parameters.name: role_type

parameters.help_en: The user ID of a member. An administrator can switch to the perspective of the member
parameters.help_zh: 管理员切换成其他成员视角的用户ID
parameters.name: role_for

parameters.help_en:
The region of the data management center for threat analysis. Select a region based on the location of your assets. Valid values:

- cn-hangzhou: The assets are in the Chinese mainland or China (Hong Kong).

- ap-southeast-1: The assets are in a region outside China
parameters.help_zh:
威胁分析的数据管理中心所在地。您需要根据资产所在地域，选择管理中心所在地。取值：
- cn-hangzhou：资产属于中国内地与中国香港
- ap-southeast-1：资产属于海外地域
